entries.title: GPT-6.1 Terra starts in medium for Codex
entries.body: A new Codex sign-in starts GPT-6.1 Terra in the medium level, in place of GPT-6.1 Sol, which keeps high. Reset to starting levels puts them there too. Levels you have already set stay as they are.

picture.alt: Codex GPT-6.1 Sol in the high level and GPT-6.1 Terra in the medium level in Settings.
